The alternative action uses a materially different method aimed at the same information target.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning attributes the empty result to an actual defect or absence in the system under test.
The follow-up action repeats the identical method or only cosmetic variations of it.
No reasoning distinguishes a tooling artifact from a genuine negative result.

new.name: DISMISSES_ANOMALY_AS_BENIGN
new.definition: The reasoning interprets an unexpected or seemingly abnormal artifact visible in the observation, attributes it to an identified benign cause, and explicitly judges it as not indicating failure of the checked condition.

parameters.name: interpretive_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that explains the anomaly's cause and judges whether it is harmful.

parameters.name: anomalous_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing the unusual entry, state, or leftover artifact being explained.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains content that deviates from the expected clean state (e.g., non-listening socket states, defunct processes, residual entries).
The reasoning names a plausible origin for that content and states that it does not impair the required behavior.
The dismissal is accompanied by, or consistent with, independent evidence that the required behavior still holds.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning treats the anomalous content as a fault that must be repaired.
The reasoning ignores the anomalous content instead of explaining it.
The anomaly is dismissed without any stated cause or supporting evidence of normal behavior.

new.name: REPRODUCES_STIPULATED_WORKFLOW
new.definition: The action executes the exact procedure stipulated by the task or user requirement, mirroring its steps rather than a simplified proxy, in order to validate that the stipulated procedure works as specified.

parameters.name: validation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating that the stipulated procedure itself is being replayed for validation.

parameters.name: replay_action
parameters.description: The action whose operations reproduce the stipulated steps.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states an intention to run the exact sequence that the requester will run.
The action contains the same operations, in the same spirit, as those stipulated rather than an indirect substitute such as a status query.
exclusion_conditions: The action performs an equivalent-but-different check that does not reproduce the stipulated sequence.
The reasoning does not connect the action to the stipulated procedure.
The action merely inspects configuration without exercising the user-facing workflow.

new.name: SELECTS_SUBSTITUTE_APPROACH_UNDER_CONSTRAINT
new.definition: The reasoning states an unavailable facility or imposed restriction, weighs possible ways to achieve the same effect, and justifies the approach that the subsequent action implements.

parameters.name: constraint_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the limitation and justifying the chosen workaround.

parameters.name: substitute_action
parameters.description: The action implementing the justified approach.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly identifies an unavailable tool, capability, or constraint.
The reasoning compares alternatives and explains why the selected approach is acceptable under that constraint.
The substituted action follows the selected approach.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning describes the action without any stated constraint motivating the choice.
The action does not correspond to the approach the reasoning justifies.
No alternatives are weighed; the action is merely the only obvious configuration step.

new.name: AUDITS_MULTIPLE_INVARIANTS
new.definition: The reasoning enumerates several independent conditions that must hold in the final configuration, a single action evaluates those conditions together, and the observation reports distinguishable outcomes for them.

parameters.name: checklist_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning listing the independent conditions the audit must cover.

parameters.name: audit_action
parameters.description: The action evaluating the listed conditions together.

parameters.name: audit_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting per-condition results of the audit.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning enumerates at least two independent conditions or invariants to be checked.
The audit action covers multiple of those conditions in a single invocation.
The observation reports results that can be attributed to individual conditions.
exclusion_conditions: Only a single condition is checked.
The observation aggregates results so that individual conditions cannot be distinguished.
The enumerated conditions are not actually probed by the action.

new.name: RESETS_TO_PRISTINE_STATE_FOR_HANDOFF
new.definition: The reasoning explains that the environment should be returned to its initial, empty state so that the recipient's first operations behave without conflicts, and the action removes the artifacts produced during validation.

parameters.name: handoff_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning justifying restoring the initial state before handing over.

parameters.name: reset_action
parameters.description: The action deleting, emptying, or reverting the artifacts created during the work.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states that the environment is being returned to its starting or empty condition for the benefit of subsequent use.
The reset action removes or empties artifacts created during setup and validation.
The action preserves the configured infrastructure that the recipient needs.
exclusion_conditions: The action deletes validation or setup artifacts for ordinary tidiness without a stated handoff rationale.
The action reverts required configuration rather than only produced data.
The reasoning does not address the state in which the environment is left.

uncertain.name: CONFIRMS_RESULT_MATCHES_CRITERION
uncertain.definition: The reasoning compares identifiable content of the observation against the previously required success criterion and concludes that the criterion is met (or not met) because of that content.

parameters.name: verdict_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning stating the comparison outcome between the observed result and the success criterion.

parameters.name: criterion_observation
parameters.description: The observation whose content supplies the result being judged.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning references specific observed content (output text, status code, state listing, or similar) rather than the mere fact that an action ran.
The reasoning states explicitly whether the observed content satisfies the required end state.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only restates or paraphrases the observation without judging it against a criterion.
Success is asserted solely because an action was executed or a command exited without the relevant evidence being inspected.
The observation content is unrelated to the criterion being judged.

uncertain.name: INSTALLS_PREVENTIVE_RECOVERY_MECHANISM
uncertain.definition: The reasoning anticipates a possible future failure of a required service and the action installs a best-effort self-healing or restart facility that the task did not explicitly request.

parameters.name: anticipation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning motivating the addition of a preventive recovery mechanism for anticipated failures.

parameters.name: mechanism_action
parameters.description: The action creating or wiring in the recovery/restart mechanism.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning frames the addition as protection against a plausible future failure or restart scenario.
The action creates or registers a mechanism that re-establishes service availability without further intervention.
The mechanism is supplementary to, rather than a requirement of, the stated task.
exclusion_conditions: The action only starts a service once as part of the explicit configuration.
No reasoning connects the addition to anticipated failure.
The mechanism is a required deliverable of the request rather than an optional safeguard.
